rules: Implement getSafeRedirectPath(path: string | null): string in a new helper file
Whitelist allowed paths: '/', '/booking', '/history', '/admin' and their subpaths
Strictly prohibit external URLs (http/https), protocol-relative URLs (//), and unknown paths
Default to '/' if input is invalid or empty
acceptance: Helper correctly filters malicious or external URLs
Tests cover empty, valid, and invalid path scenarios

rules: Redirect authenticated users with valid tokens from /login to '/' (Rule #136)
Implement server-side role check for /admin (OWNER only)
Return 401/403 for API requests instead of redirecting (Rule #32)
Integrate the new getSafeRedirectPath for all redirection logic
acceptance: Infinite redirect loop is resolved by not deleting valid tokens
Unauthorized role access to /admin returns 403 (for API) or redirects to / (for page)

rules: Registration success MUST NOT trigger auto-login (Rule #99)
After registration, switch to login view and clear password (Rule #108)
Do not auto-create accounts if email doesn't exist during login (Rule #101)
Pass 'redirect' parameter to profile completion flow if needed
Default successful login redirect to '/' instead of '/booking' (Rule #78)
acceptance: Registration flow requires manual login afterwards
Login flow correctly preserves the redirect path through profile completion
